title: org.siontology.ap2
description: The ACP extension org.siontology.ap2: AP2 v0.2 mandates and receipts on a checkout session. It adds $.CheckoutSession.ap2 (what the merchant offers and answers) and $.CheckoutSessionCompleteRequest.ap2 (what the buyer presents).

checkout_jwt.description: The checkout the merchant signed (ES256), in UCP's shape: what a checkout mandate carries and hashes as checkout_hash.

audience.description: The aud the closing hop of each mandate must name.

nonce.description: The nonce the closing hop of each mandate must name; it changes whenever the session is priced again.

merchant.description: The merchant as an AP2 payee: what a payment mandate must name.

checkout_receipt.description: The merchant's signed checkout receipt (JWT), once a mandate was answered.

payment_receipt.description: The merchant's signed payment receipt (JWT), once a payment mandate was answered.

checkout_mandate.description: A Delegate SD-JWT chain ending in a closed mandate.checkout.1.

payment_mandate.description: A Delegate SD-JWT chain ending in a closed mandate.payment.1 for the session's total, to the merchant.
